body:
Addressed: the merge conflict in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs` is resolved locally. Both tests are kept. The merge is not pushed.

Merged main into this branch locally (maintainer edit, approved by the reporter). Local head: `2aa36849081210e4929dd04d09391c4076bb8bfd`. Main: `582981bfa`.

Gate: RED. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` planned 3 steps. The build and 307 app unit tests passed. The original UI link pins passed, including `an_unauthenticated_client_holding_the_link_times_out_and_releases_it`.

The retained main test `a_second_ui_call_during_a_slow_call_reports_busy_and_exits_4` hung for more than 60 seconds. Its first client sends no hello (`ui_link.rs:242-250`). The new 5-second limit closes that connection. Its second client then authenticates and waits for a response. The test does not serve that request (`ui_link.rs:258-259`). The authenticated client has no read timeout (`link_client.rs:140`).

The gate was stopped. Clippy and example_catalog did not run. No production logic or test logic was changed. This interaction needs a test or logic change beyond the approved merge refresh. Review is blocked. The clean warm worktree remains at `.claude/worktrees/fix-3881`.

Addressed review feedback:
1. Merged `upstream/main` into the branch.
2. Resolved the conflict in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs`:
- Kept both `an_unauthenticated_client_holding_the_link_times_out_and_releases_it` and `a_second_ui_call_during_a_slow_call_reports_busy_and_exits_4`.
- Updated client 1 in `a_second_ui_call_during_a_slow_call_reports_busy_and_exits_4` to authenticate using `link_connect`. This change accurately models an active session and prevents the server from dropping client 1 on the 5-second pre-hello deadline, eliminating the timeout and hang.
3. Verification passed:
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live ui_link` (7 passed, 0 failed in 7.31s)
- `cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean)
- Line count: `ui_link.rs` is 261 lines (<= 400 lines)

Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c13f38d412eab90185ff587680aab230a9041d45 -->
This review is clean. No blocking findings.

I read the full diff and issue #3873. I checked the rules in current upstream/main AGENTS.md.

Previous reported problems:
- Merge conflict: fixed in c13f38d412eab90185ff587680aab230a9041d45. Both UI link tests remain. The trial merge with current main is clean.
- Busy-window test hang: fixed in the same commit. Client 1 now authenticates with `link_connect` at `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs:242`. The full suite passed locally.

The listener applies the short deadline and small buffer limit before token validation. After validation, it uses the normal session limits. The timeout test shows that a second client can get a session.

Local results:
- PR head: `c13f38d412eab90185ff587680aab230a9041d45`.
- Main base: `02d05bc1c94e6042a75882faad8b57e055fb4de3`.
- Trial merge: `62128ae09f9e090aeaf463c528ce0d5102060f06`. Its first parent is the PR head.
- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=8 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. Build passed. App unit tests: 307 passed. Full `mcp_live` suite: 21 passed, including all seven UI link tests. No failures.
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.

Extra suites run:
- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=8 cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`: PASS. All 11 light tests passed across five targets. Each target built as needed. The separate build of all test binaries was omitted.
- Motion lib: 7 passed. `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start`: 1 passed each.
- Fixture, importer, and example catalog suites: not applicable. The PR changes none of those files or their production code.

Mutations: not run. This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.
Goldens moved: none. Screenshots: not applicable; no `crates/ui` change.
Full heavy lanes: not run; they are not required for this change.

The PR is MERGEABLE. I left the draft state, labels, title, and branch unchanged, as instructed for this review. The review worktree and build cache remain available.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand. Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 3881 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
